`/Users/xxx/Desktop/remani-bench` is the independent original-REMANI
laboratory.

This directory stores the comparison protocol and compact imported results:

- original REMANI bridge-search ablation at four bridge heights;
- TopAY native benchmark and shared dynamic-track experiments;
- GCDF published tables and execution environment.

Full external source trees and build workspaces remain in `remani-bench`.
